title: clone_home and main_worktree resolve a relative gitdir against the working directory
goal: kbfacts.clone_home, ql_base.clone_home and bl_base.main_worktree resolve a linked worktree's relative gitdir: line (git worktree add --relative-paths, worktree.useRelativePaths) against the worktree, not the process's working directory, so a tool run from any directory finds the clone's main worktree and its shared _cache/ and spool. Found by the SP-eahtellz review.

run: import subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,os,shutil;g=lambda *a:s.run(['git',*a],capture_output=True,text=True);top=os.path.dirname(os.path.realpath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),g('rev-parse','--git-common-dir').stdout.strip())));t=tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=os.path.dirname(top));d=os.path.join(t,'wt');p=g('worktree','add','-q','--relative-paths','--detach',d);rel=p.returncode==0 and open(os.path.join(d,'.git')).read().startswith('gitdir: ..');e={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':os.path.join(d,'_tools')};r=s.run([sys.executable,'-c','import sys,kbfacts,bl_base,ql_base;print(kbfacts.clone_home());print(ql_base.clone_home());print(bl_base.main_worktree(sys.argv[1]))',d],cwd=t,env=e,capture_output=True,text=True) if rel else None;got=[os.path.realpath(x) for x in r.stdout.split()] if r else [];shutil.rmtree(d,ignore_errors=True);g('worktree','prune');shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True);print('main worktree',top,'| relative gitdir planted',rel,'| from another cwd',got);sys.exit(2 if not rel else 0 if len(got)==3 and all(x==top for x in got) else 1)
